$Comment: How the Voidtaken Horseman flies in the saddle: the Headless Horseman's own ride
(Hallows_Eve/Components/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Ride.json, its comment tells every move), with the void in
place of his fire. His role (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Voidtaken_Horseman_Mounted) names this file in
CombatAdditionalBehaviorComponent, the hook Template_Flying_Aggressive runs ahead of its own combat moves
on every tick he is fighting.
It references the Horseman's ride whole and changes one of its parameters through Modify: LineDrop, the
bomb his bomb pass drops onto each ring, is the void bomb (Root_Seasons_Of_Orbis_Voidtaken_Line_Drop),
so the row bursts in the void. Every other move, timing and flight point is the Horseman's, measured
from where he spawned; the Voidtaken's marker keeps the Horseman's spot on the plaza's north side, so
the same moves fit the same graveyard. Retune a move for him alone by naming that parameter in Modify
below; change it in the Horseman's file to move both.

LineDrop.Description: The root interaction dropped onto each ring of a bomb pass. It should fall from high above, about 2 seconds.
